summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of UI/UX light theme overhaul. All core pages load correctly with new premium light theme (slate/white backgrounds, glassmorphism effects, professional typography). Hero, featured events, categories, trust sections, reviews, and footer all display properly. No Helmet errors or runtime errors detected.

issues: Dropdown overlay intercepts clicks - requires Escape or clicking dropdown itself to close (minor UX issue with shadcn dropdown component)

critical_code_review_comments: Light theme CSS variables properly defined in index.css with glassmorphism effects
All pages use consistent light backgrounds (hsl(210,20%,98%))
Event cards have glass-card hover effects with proper shadows
Trust ticker animates smoothly with buyer protection badges
Framer-motion animations load properly for hero and sections
Mobile sticky buy button appears correctly on < 1024px viewport
Mobile menu toggle works and expands with category links
Footer has proper payment badges, trust elements, and legal disclaimer
All data-testid attributes present for interactive elements

Mobile responsiveness verified. No Helmet or runtime errors. 401 console errors are expected for unauthenticated API calls (alerts, auth endpoints).
